messages:
nina (new-hire): Hey all, Nina here. First rotation is tomorrow. Quick wins checklist? runbook access, pager routing, and local debug creds for model-serving.
rafa (oncall-lead): Welcome Nina! Runbooks live in Confluence > Reliability > Oncall Runbooks. If you can't open them give your SSO. Pager = OpsGenie; make sure push + SMS enabled. Local debug creds are provided via Vault; see runbook section 'Access'.
setup-bot: Action required: Please complete MFA enrollment and device approval: https://idm.redwood.internal/mfa
nena (typo): (this is me fixing my name lol)
nina (new-hire): SSO is nina@redwood.com. I can view runbooks but the debug creds link 404s.
tara (sre): There's a caching bug with the confluence macro. Try the direct Vault link: https://vault.redwood.internal/secrets/oncall/model-debug. If you still get 403 ping me.
rafa (oncall-lead): Note: debug creds are time-limited (12h) and bound to your machine's SSH key. Add your key to the onboarding doc and we'll mint.
nina (new-hire): I added my key. Also when I run `curl http://model-serving.internal/health` from my laptop I get "502 Bad Gateway" but from jumpbox it's fine. Any tips?
tara (sre): Likely your traffic isn't routed via the internal CIDR. Two quick checks: 1) Are you on the corp VPN? run `tailscale status` or `sudo ip route` 2) Try `ssh jumpbox` and curl from there. If jumpbox works, file a ticket for network team and we can temporarily proxy.
nina (new-hire): `tailscale status` shows connected, but `ip route` has no 10.0.0.0/8 route.
rafa (oncall-lead): That's the VLAN provisioning quirk during new hires. I think ops-provision didn't push the internal route. @tara can add route or escalate to infra.
tara (sre): I pushed the route fix for your user. Try again now.
nina (new-hire): Health check now returns 200. Thanks!
sam (eng-manager): Two small onboarding notes: 1) During first two shifts you are shadowed; no solo escalations unless you and your shadow agree. 2) Use the incident template verbatim for exec notices.
rafa (oncall-lead): Also short-runbook tip: the "quick mitigation" section lists 3 commands to run for model-serving backpressure: `kubectl scale deployment/model-ingress --replicas=0`, `redis-cli flushall`, and restart the ingest service. Only do these under guidance from SRE when traffic patterns match the checklist.
nina (new-hire): Copy. Last Q: who do I call if OpsGenie starts spamming duplicate alerts?
rafa (oncall-lead): Ping #eng-oncall and DM me + @tara. If it's a platform-wide duplicate alerting loop, page infra-pager.
pagerbot: Scheduled: Nina shadow with Rafa  2026-04-05 23:00-07:00 UTC.
setup-bot: Note: MFA + device approval complete for nina@redwood.com.
